tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and end by H=0.48, far short of the H=23 forecast target. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the early gain reverses and constrains the late response before fitting the model.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-exponential adaptation fit on the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. The two parameters can trade off while giving different forecasts at H=23.
A positive early rise is compatible with monotone relaxation, but the pilot does not establish whether the response stays positive or reverses.
Finer sampling would help resolve fast transients, but the key uncertainty is the response at long horizons.
